text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! My very cells are burning
with
energy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My power is growing stronger and
stronger! I feel
like a completely
different person to who I was
just a few
moments ago!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's as if I've evolved! Excellent! Now I'm
another
step closer to taking on the
world!
